import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path=Path('results/training/qwen38_b4_validation.json');assert not path.exists()
plan_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_b4_validation_plan.json');plan=json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
folder=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_b4_validation');meta=json.loads((folder/'kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
assert meta==plan['metadata'] and meta['is_private'] and meta['enable_gpu'] and meta['enable_internet']
assert file_sha256(folder/meta['code_file'])==plan['source_sha256']
protocol=json.loads(Path('results/protocol.json').read_text());assert protocol['evaluation']['final_candidates']==11
assert json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_batch_probe_completion.json').read_text())['status']=='eligible_registered_for_validation'
env={**os.environ,'KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR':str(Path('runs/kaggle_oauth_config').resolve())}
for name in ('KAGGLE_KEY','KAGGLE_API_TOKEN','KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE'):env.pop(name,None)
subprocess.run(['/Users/nico/.local/share/uv/tools/kaggle/bin/python','scripts/kaggle_quota.py'],env=env,check=True)
snapshot=json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text());quota=snapshot['quota']
available=quota['gpu_seconds_total']-quota['gpu_seconds_used']-quota['gpu_seconds_reserved']
other=json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_primary_grpo_validation.json').read_text())
remaining_other=max(0,other['session_timeout_seconds']-(datetime.now(timezone.utc)-datetime.fromisoformat(other['submitted_at'])).total_seconds()) if other['status']=='submitted' else 0
reserve=plan['selected_test_reserve_seconds'];cap=plan['session_timeout_seconds']
assert available>=remaining_other+reserve+cap,'Insufficient quota after the running native validation and complete selected-test reserve'
command=['kaggle','kernels','push','-p',str(folder),'--accelerator','NvidiaTeslaT4','--timeout',str(cap)]
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'registered primary batch-four SFT/GRPO validation; fixed seed zero'},plan['provenance']['model_revision']),
    'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'plan_sha256':file_sha256(plan_path),'metadata':meta,'source_sha256':plan['source_sha256'],
    'quota_snapshot':snapshot,'available_seconds':available,'remaining_native_grpo_cap_seconds':remaining_other,
    'selected_test_reserve_seconds':reserve,'session_timeout_seconds':cap,'status':'submitting',
    'submitted_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'polls':[]}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
result=subprocess.run(command,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
record['push']={'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout,'error':result.stderr}
version=re.search(r'Kernel version (\d+)',result.stdout);actual=re.search(r'https://www.kaggle.com/code/([^/\s]+/[^/\s]+)',result.stdout)
if actual:record['requested_kernel']=meta['id'];meta['id']=actual[1]
record.update(status='submitted' if result.returncode==0 and version else 'push_requires_inspection',version=int(version[1]) if version else None)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');assert record['status']=='submitted','Inspect ambiguous submission before any retry'
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json');ledger=json.loads(p.read_text())
ledger['sessions'].append({'kernel':meta['id'],'version':record['version'],'accelerator':'T4 x2 requested','start':None,'end':None,'hours':None,
    'submitted_at':record['submitted_at'],'private':True,'status':'submitted','source_commit':record['provenance']['git_commit'],
    'receipt':str(path),'session_timeout_seconds':cap,'purpose':'Primary batch-four SFT/GRPO validation pair, 100/game; distinct inference policies.',
    'hours_basis':'Pending downloaded runtime; cap is not measured usage.'})
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n');print('Submitted',meta['id'],record['version'],flush=True)
subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python','-u','scripts/watch_kaggle.py','--receipt',str(path),'--out',f"results/kaggle/qwen38-b4-validation-v{record['version']}"],check=True)
